description: This file is a shell library containing functions to test credential helpers in a git environment. It includes functions to check, approve, reject, and test credential helper behaviors, including handling of long headers, timeouts, password expiry, OAuth tokens, authtypes, and multiple credentials. It also defines a simple askpass script used for automated credential input.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Executes a credential helper command with provided arguments, reads input data, and compares actual outputs against expected outputs.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads input lines until a '--' delimiter and outputs them, used for parsing credential data.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Clears residual credential data from previous tests by rejecting common credential entries.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejets a specific credential using credential helper with given parameters.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Performs a series of tests on the specified credential helper, including storage, retrieval, overwriting, and deletion of credentials, as well as handling long headers and multiple users.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving password expiry UTC field.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving OAuth refresh tokens.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving authtype and credential data with various combinations and capabilities.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Defines a simple shell script for an askpass helper that outputs a token based on input.
